mapper.select: SELECT product_id, product_code, product_name, service_code, total_count, price FROM erp_bookstore_product WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_payment (order_no, group_order_no, student_id, center_code, product_id, product_name, service_code, billing_ym, amount, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{groupOrderNo}, #{studentId}, #{centerCode}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{serviceCode}, #{billingYm}, #{amount}, 'READY', DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.sql: payment_id, order_no, group_order_no, billing_ym, tid, student_id, center_code, product_id, product_name, service_code, amount, refund_amount, status, paid_at
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment SET tid = #{tid}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, card_name = #{cardName}, card_no = #{cardNo}, appl_no = #{applNo}, result_code = #{resultCode}, status = 'PAID', paid_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('READY', 'CLOSED')
UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment SET result_code = #{resultCode}, status = 'FAILED' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_payment WHERE status = 'READY' AND requested_at < #{olderThan}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment SET refund_amount = refund_amount + #{cancelAmount}, status = CASE WHEN refund_amount + #{cancelAmount} >= amount THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE status END WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status IN ('PAID') AND refund_amount + #{cancelAmount} <= amount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_payment_cancel (payment_id, cancel_amount, reason, requested_by, rule_code, used_days, used_count, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{cancelAmount}, #{reason}, #{requestedBy}, #{ruleCode}, #{usedDays}, #{usedCount}, 'REQ', DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment_cancel SET status = #{status}, cancel_tid = #{cancelTid}, result_code = #{resultCode}, result_msg = #{resultMsg}, canceled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' THEN DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) ELSE canceled_at END WHERE cancel_id = #{cancelId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_payment_log (order_no, tid, log_type, http_status, result_code, req_body, res_body, created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{tid}, #{logType}, #{httpStatus}, #{resultCode}, #{reqBody}, #{resBody}, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.select: SELECT rule_code, rule_name, max_days, max_count, refund_rate FROM erp_bookstore_refund_rule WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC
mapper.sql: p.payment_id, p.student_id, s.student_name, p.group_order_no, p.order_no, p.product_name, p.amount, p.refund_amount, p.status, p.card_name, p.card_no, p.requested_at, p.paid_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_payment p LEFT JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = p.student_id WHERE p.group_order_no = #{groupOrderNo} ORDER BY p.requested_at

SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, order_no AS orderNo, group_order_no AS groupOrderNo, student_id AS studentId, center_code AS centerCode, product_name AS productName, amount, status, review_reason AS reviewReason, requested_at AS requestedAt FROM erp_bookstore_payment WHERE needs_review = 1 AND reviewed_at IS NULL ORDER BY requested_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment SET reviewed_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND needs_review = 1 AND reviewed_at IS NULL
UPDATE erp_bookstore_payment SET refund_requested_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND refund_requested_at IS NULL AND refund_amount = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_payment WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_recheck_at IS NULL AND requested_at >= #{windowStart}
